app_name: MILLO — A New Way to Snack
theme: vibrant Gen Z snack brand with dark mode energy, bold neon accents, and clean editorial structure
components: Navbar with live cart badge and quick links
Hero Section with CRUNCH DIFFERENT. SNACK BETTER. headline and interactive CTA
Offer Banner for Mix & Match Cravings (3x30g combo at ₹79)
Product Catalog (MILLO CRUNCH, MILLO POPS, MILLO CRISPS) with 30g ₹29 / 60g ₹59 pack selectors and quick add-to-cart
Why MILLO (Made with Millet, Baked Not Fried, No Maida, Fibre & Plant Protein)
Product Detail View (Modal or dedicated view with ingredients, allergens, storage, delivery)
Working Slide-over Cart with quantity controls and combo discount calc
Order-Intent Checkout Form with delivery details and instant confirmation screen
Footer with newsletter signup and brand links

accessibility.contrast_target: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text and UI controls)
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respected via CSS and animation wrappers
